title: Integrating RNA-seq and scRNA-seq to explore the biological significance of NAD + metabolism-related genes in the initial diagnosis and relapse of childhood B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
authors: Lin, Chao; Xu, Jia-Qi; Zhong, Gui-Chao; Chen, Hui; Xue, Hong-Man; Yang, Mo; Chen, Chun
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用RNA-seq和scRNA-seq分析B-ALL中NAD代谢相关基因，虽涉及转录因子CREB3L2，但核心是表达差异与免疫细胞分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide (NAD) depletion is reported to be a potential treatment for B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (B-ALL), but the mechanism of NAD metabolism-related genes (NMRGs) in B-ALL relapse remains unclear. METHODS: Transcriptome data (GSE3912), and single-cell sequencing data (GSE130116) of B-ALL patients were downloaded from Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. NMRGs were sourced from Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) and Reactome databases. Further, the differentially expressed NMRGs (DE-NMRGs) were selected from the analysis between initial diagnosis and relapse B-ALL samples, which further performed functional enrichment analyses. The biomarkers were obtained through random forest (RF) algorithm and repeated cross validation. Additionally, cell type identification by estimating relative subsets of RNA transcripts (CIBERSORT) algorithm was used to evaluate the immune cell differences between the initial diagnosis and relapse samples, and the correlations between biomarkers and gene markers of differential immune cells were analyzed. Furthermore, single cell RNA sequencing was conducted in the GSE130116 dataset to find key cell clusters. In addition, according to biomarkers expressions, cell clusters were categorized into high and low biomarker expression groups, and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) analysis was performed on them. Finally, the cell clusters with the highest expression of biomarkers were selected to explore the roles of biomarkers in different cell clusters and identify transcription factors (TFs) influencing biological markers. RESULTS: 23 DE-NMRGs were screened out, which were mainly enriched in nucleoside phosphate metabolic process, nucleotide metabolic process, and Nicotinate and nicotinamide metabolism. Moreover, 3 biomarkers (NADSYN1, SIRT3, and PARP6) were identified from the machine learning. CIBERSORT results demonstrated that four types of immune cells (B Cells naive, Monocyte, Neutrophils, and T cells CD4 memory Activated) were significantly different between the initial diagnosis and the relapse B-ALL samples, and there were strong correlations between biomarkers and differential immune cells such as positive correlation between NADSYN1 and B Cells naive. The single cell analyses showed that the biomarkers were highly expressed in common myeloid progenitors (CMP), granulocyte-macrophage progenitor (GMP), and megakaryocyte-erythroid progenitor (MEP) cell clusters. Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) results indicated that 55 GO terms and 3 KEGG pathways were enriched by the genes in high and low biomarker expression groups. It was found that TF CREB3L2(+) was significantly reduced in the high expression group, which may be the TF affecting biomarkers in the high expression group. CONCLUSION: This study identified NADSYN1, SIRT3, and PARP6 as the biomarkers of B-ALL, explored biological significance of NMRGs in the initial diagnosis and relapse of B-ALL, and revealed mechanism of biomarkers at the level of the single cell.
abstract_zh: 背景：据报道，烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD）耗竭是B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病（B-ALL）的潜在治疗方法，但NAD代谢相关基因（NMRGs）在B-ALL复发中的机制仍不清楚。方法：从基因表达综合（GEO）数据库下载B-ALL患者的转录组数据（GSE3912）和单细胞测序数据（GSE130116）。NMRGs来源于京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）和Reactome数据库。进一步，从初诊和复发B-ALL样本之间的分析中筛选出差异表达的NMRGs（DE-NMRGs），并对其进行功能富集分析。通过随机森林（RF）算法和重复交叉验证获得生物标志物。此外，通过估计RNA转录本的相对子集进行细胞类型鉴定（CIBERSORT）算法用于评估初诊和复发样本之间的免疫细胞差异，并分析生物标志物与差异免疫细胞基因标记之间的相关性。进一步，在GSE130116数据集中进行单细胞RNA测序以找到关键细胞簇。此外，根据生物标志物表达，将细胞簇分为高和低生物标志物表达组，并对其进行基因集富集分析（GSEA）。最后，选择生物标志物表达最高的细胞簇，以探索生物标志物在不同细胞簇中的作用，并识别影响生物标志物的转录因子（TFs）。结果：筛选出23个DE-NMRGs，主要富集在核苷磷酸代谢过程、核苷酸代谢过程以及烟酸和烟酰胺代谢中。此外，通过机器学习识别出3个生物标志物（NADSYN1、SIRT3和PARP6）。CIBERSORT结果表明，四种免疫细胞（初始B细胞、单核细胞、中性粒细胞和CD4记忆活化T细胞）在初诊和复发B-ALL样本之间存在显著差异，并且生物标志物与差异免疫细胞之间存在强相关性，如NADSYN1与初始B细胞之间的正相关。单细胞分析显示，生物标志物在常见髓系祖细胞（CMP）、粒细胞-巨噬细胞祖细胞（GMP）和巨核细胞-红细胞祖细胞（MEP）细胞簇中高表达。基因集富集分析（GSEA）结果表明，高和低生物标志物表达组中的基因富集了55个GO术语和3条KEGG通路。发现TF CREB3L2(+)在高表达组中显著减少，这可能是影响高表达组生物标志物的TF。结论：本研究将NADSYN1、SIRT3和PARP6确定为B-ALL的生物标志物，探讨了NMRGs在B-ALL初诊和复发中的生物学意义，并在单细胞水平上揭示了生物标志物的机制。
